question.problem: Determine if the vector $u$ lies on the plane $Π:r=sb+tc,$ $t,s\in R$, where  $b=⟨1,3,6⟩$, $c=⟨1,-2,4⟩$, and  $u=⟨3,19,-10⟩.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of $s\cdot t$ from the decomposition $u=sb+tc.$
question.worked_solution:
By definition, $u\in Π$ if there exist $t$ and $s$ such that

$$
\begin{aligned}sb+tc & =u \\ s[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 6\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 19 \\ -10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s+t=3 \\ 3s-2t=19 \\ 6s+4t=-10\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & -2 & 19 \\ 6 & 4 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -5 & 10 \\ 6 & 4 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-6{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & -5 & 10 \\ 0 & -2 & -28\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=-\frac{1}{5}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & -2 & -28\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -32\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The third row of the augmented matrix now corresponds to the equation $0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}=-32,$ which has no solution.

So, there are no values of $s$ and $t$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}sb+tc=u.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that $u$ does *not* lie on the plane $Π.$
